verdict.rationale: Cooley GO offers a free YC Safe document generator in several versions (US, UK and Singapore) and a Series Seed equity financing package. Cooley's emerging companies practice states it handles 2,100+ VC financings a year, and an independent Hacker News comment corroborates Cooley GO as a go-to source of startup financing forms. Missing for 10: no evidenced SAFE-specific explainer or guidance article, no evidence of convertible note forms beyond the SAFE, and no independent corroboration specific to the SAFE tooling.
